Title: Jerusalem, The Holy City
Description: A Song of Ascent. Of David.

Verses.1:
I was glad when they said to me,
	"Let us go to the house of the LORD."
Verses.2:
Our feet are standing
	within your gates, Jerusalem.
Verses.3:
Jerusalem, you are built as a city
	that is firmly bound together.
Verses.4:
The tribes go up to you, the tribes of the LORD,
	as was decreed for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
Verses.5:
For there the thrones of judgement were set,
	the thrones of the house of David.
Verses.6:
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem,
	"May those who love you prosper.
Verses.7:
May peace reign within your walls,
	and prosperity within your palaces."
Verses.8:
For the sake of my family and friends,
	I will say, "May peace reign within you."
Verses.9:
For the sake of the House of the LORD our God,
	I will seek your good.
